h1:
给平面设计师的 AI 设计工具。
每一层都能接着改。
AI design for graphic designers. Every layer stays editable.
sub: 说清楚要做的海报、社媒图或主视觉，拿回来的是分好层的稿子。改字、挪位置、换图都在原稿上做，不用从头生成。
Describe a poster, a social post or a key visual, and get it back in layers. Change the type, move things and swap images on the same file, without starting over.
note: 适用于 Apple Silicon Mac · 应用经 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证
For Apple Silicon Macs · App signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple
trust1: Apple Silicon 原生 · 应用已通过 Apple 公证
Built for Apple Silicon · App notarized by Apple
trust2: 作品、版本和对话都留在你的 Mac 上
Artwork, versions and chats stay on your Mac
trust3: 用你自己的模型和密钥，不需要 Molly 账户
Your own models and keys. No Molly account
trust4: 在应用里检查更新，也可以随时手动下载
Check for updates in the app, or download any time
demo_h: 在 Molly 里实际截下来的
demo_lead: 真实录屏和截图，不是效果图：一段改字的短录屏，以及展开的导出菜单。
A real screen recording and a real screenshot, not mockups: changing one word, and the Export menu.
wf_lead: 按真实接单的顺序走一遍：写简报、找参考、挑方向、落图层、回修、导出。
One job in the order real work goes: brief, references, direction, layers, revisions, export.
wf_end: 下一轮改稿来了，你打开的还是同一份文件。
When the next round of changes comes in, you open the same file.
p1_h: 不是一张图，是一份能改的稿
Not a flat picture. A file you can keep working on
p1_lead: 一键出图给你的是一张扁平图片，改一个字就得重来。Molly 交给你的稿子已经分好层。
One-shot tools give you a flat picture, and changing one word means starting over. Molly gives you a file that is already in layers.
p1_b1: 标题、日期、地点都是文字图层，选中就能改字、换字体、调字号和对齐。
Titles, dates and venues are text layers. Select one to reword it or change the font, size and alignment.
p1_b2: 圆、线和小图形是独立的矢量图层，可以单独移动和改色。
Circles, rules and small marks are separate vector layers you can move and recolour on their own.
p1_b3: 图像模型只负责画面那一层，标题和小字不会被画进图里。
The image model only makes the picture layer. Headlines and small print are never baked into it.
p2_h: It looks around first, then offers directions
p2_lead: 动手之前，Agent 会先自己去找参考，再拿出几套方向。选哪一套由你决定，它再接着往下做。
Before it builds anything, the agent goes looking for references on its own and comes back with a few directions. You choose one, and it carries on from there.
p3_h: 稿子和密钥都在你的 Mac 上
Your files and keys stay on your Mac
p3_lead: 作品、版本和对话存在本地。模型请求直接发给你自己配置的服务商。
Artwork, versions and chats are stored locally. Model requests go straight to the providers you set up.
p3_l1: 作品、版本和对话都存在本地，不需要 Molly 云账户。
Artwork, versions and chats are stored locally. No Molly cloud account.
p3_l2: 密钥存在系统加密存储里。第一次启动时，macOS 可能会请求允许 Molly 使用钥匙串，选「始终允许」即可。
Keys are kept in the system’s encrypted storage. On first launch macOS may ask to let Molly use the Keychain. Choose Always Allow.
p3_l3: 模型和图片的费用由你配置的服务商直接收取，Molly 不代收，也不转售。
The providers you configure bill you directly for model and image use. Molly doesn’t collect or resell it.
p3_l4: 换电脑或备份时，作品和数据可以直接拷走；加密保存的密钥可能需要在新机器上重新填一次。
When you back up or move to a new Mac, your work copies over like any files. Encrypted keys may need to be entered again on the new machine.
cases_h: 都是 Molly 做出来的
cases_lead: 下面每一张都是在 Molly 里跑出来、直接导出的稿子。品牌和活动都是虚构的。
Every piece below was made in Molly and exported as is. The brands and events are made up.
m_lead: 在设置 → AI 模型里添加连接。每个会话可以选用哪个连接、哪个模型和思考强度。
Add connections under Settings → AI models. For each session you choose the connection, the model and how hard it thinks.
m_img: 在图片生成里填兼容的接口地址、密钥和模型，和对话模型分开设置，可以随时开关。不用图片模型，也能只用文字和形状排版。
Under Image generation, enter a compatible API address, a key and the model. It is separate from the chat model and you can switch it off. Without it, Molly still lays out type and shapes.
final_p: 免费下载。应用经 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证。
Free to download. The app is signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

why: 像给同事交代活儿一样
The way you’d brief a colleague
p: 选好尺寸，用一两句话说清楚要做什么、给谁看、想要什么感觉。内置尺寸有方图、竖版、竖屏、横版和长图，也可以交给 Agent 自己判断。
Pick a size and say in a sentence or two what it is, who it’s for and how it should feel. Square, portrait, story, landscape and long-image presets are built in, or let the agent decide.
需要的时候，Agent 会打开内置浏览器去找参考，比如维基共享资源里的公版老照片和海报，再一条条告诉你它从中借鉴了什么。
When the job calls for it, the agent opens the built-in browser to find references, such as public-domain photos and posters on Wikimedia Commons, and notes what it took from each one.

p: Agent 把几套方向并排放到画布上，附上每套的思路。你挑中一套，它就照这个往下做。
The agent lays a few directions side by side on the canvas, with a note on each. You pick one and it builds from there.
alt: 画布上并排的三套社区暗房开放日海报方向，左边是 Agent 对每套的说明
Three directions for a community darkroom open-house poster side by side on the canvas, with the agent’s note on each in the chat

why: 文字、形状、图片各占一层
Type, shapes and images each get a layer
p: 选定的方向会做成图层：文字是真文字，圆和线是形状，背景是图片。每一层都在图层面板里，可以选中、对齐，也可以填精确的数值。
The chosen direction is built as layers: real text, vector shapes and an image background. Each one sits in the Layers panel, where you can select it, align it and type exact values.

A design-week key visual on the Molly canvas, with the layer, text and shape tools below

why: 每一轮改的都是同一份文件
p: 客户想换个词，你选中文字直接改。要改得多一点，就在对话里交给 Agent，不满意还能回到之前保存的版本。
If the client wants a different word, select the text and change it. For bigger changes, ask the agent in chat, and go back to an earlier saved version if you don’t like the result.

A café poster with its headline changed to “honey oat”, the text box still selected and the matching layer highlighted in the Layers panel

why: PNG or JPEG at three scales
p: 保存后导出。交给客户的是导出的图，可编辑的工程和历史版本留在你的 Mac 上，下一轮接着改。
Save, then export. Your client gets the image. The editable file and its saved versions stay on your Mac for the next round.

faq: 系统要求是什么？
What do I need to run it?
一台 Apple Silicon 芯片的 Mac，系统为 macOS Ventura 或更新。目前不支持 Intel Mac。
A Mac with Apple Silicon running macOS Ventura or later. Intel Macs aren’t supported.
怎么安装？
How do I install it?
下载 DMG，打开后把 Molly.app 拖进「应用程序」。应用经 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证，可以直接打开。
Download the DMG, open it and drag Molly.app into Applications. The app is signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens normally.
要付费吗？模型费用谁出？
Does it cost anything? Who pays for the models?
Molly 可以免费下载。模型和图片调用的费用，由你配置的服务商直接向你收取，Molly 不代收也不转售。
Molly is free to download. The providers you configure bill you directly for model and image use. Molly doesn’t collect or resell it.
我的稿子和对话会上传到 Molly 吗？
Do my designs and chats get uploaded to Molly?
不会。作品、版本和对话都存在本地，Molly 没有云账户。模型请求直接发给你配置的服务商。
No. Artwork, versions and chats are stored locally, and Molly has no cloud account. Model requests go straight to the providers you configure.
支持哪些模型？
Which models can I use?
取决于你添加的连接：OpenAI、Kimi Code，以及任何 OpenAI 兼容接口（包括本地的 Ollama、LM Studio）。图片模型另外设置。具体能用哪些，看服务商和你的密钥。

That depends on what you connect: OpenAI, Kimi Code and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including local Ollama and LM Studio. Image models are set up separately. The exact list depends on the provider and your key.
没有图片模型能用吗？
Can I use it without an image model?
可以。只用文字和形状排版不需要图片服务，图片生成是可选的。
Yes. Layouts with type and shapes don’t need an image service. Image generation is optional.
和直接让聊天 AI「做张海报」有什么不同？
How is this different from asking a chat AI for a poster?
聊天里出图，通常给你一张扁平的结果。Molly 会先找参考、给几套方向，再把选中的方向做成可编辑的图层：可以对齐、改字、回到旧版本，最后在本机导出 PNG 或 JPEG。

A chat tool usually hands you one flat image. Molly looks for references, offers a few directions, and builds the one you pick as editable layers. You can align, reword and roll back, then export PNG or JPEG on your Mac.
能做印刷稿吗？
Can I make print files?
目前尺寸用像素预设，没有出血和毫米单位，更适合屏幕和社媒用途。
Sizes are pixel presets for now, with no bleed or millimetre units, so it suits screen and social work best.
怎么更新？
How do I update?
在应用里检查更新，也可以随时在本页重新下载 DMG。
Check for updates in the app, or download the DMG again from this page at any time.
